modes.timestamp: Stop at first event after target Unix ms
modes.tickNumber: Stop after tick N — most precise
modes.eventId: Stop just before this event was applied

schema.output: Reconstructed state + diagnostic info (failedAt, failedTemplate, reason)

content.doc: Time Travel Replay executes a controlled reconstruction of system state. Three modes: by timestamp (nearest moment), by tick number (surgical precision — the same tick IDs used in the orchestrator), or by event ID (stop just before a specific change was applied). If the replay hits a failed tick, it surfaces the same failedAt/templateId diagnostic as the live orchestrator. The past and the present speak the same language.
